name: Adhan Facets
summary: A sharply faceted mosque is balanced by two measured outward call strokes.
why: One silhouette joins a tapered minaret to a faceted hall and common y=73 foundation. The hall roof and doorway share x=50. Two stepped quarter-waves occupy the open upper-right space with repeated horizontal, diagonal, and vertical segments; generous clearance preserves both the architecture and the adhan cue.
risk: The geometric call strokes are deliberately abstract. They suggest the adhan and a prayer notification rather than literal sound equipment.
sub1: Crisp architecture with one shared foundation
sub2: The adhan expressed through Deco geometry
reasonToChoose: You want a distinct mosque that also communicates the call to prayer.
